title: Exploring Capy NFTs
description: Discover Capy, one of the first and most popular NFT collections on the Sui blockchain, featuring cute capybara characters with unique traits and breeding mechanics.

tasks.title: Prepare for Capy NFTs
tasks.description: Add at least 0.03 SUI to your wallet to prepare for NFT interactions

tasks.title: Capy Basics
tasks.description: Learn the fundamentals of the Capy NFT collection
tasks.question: What animal is featured in the Capy NFT collection?
options: Cats
Capybaras
Crocodiles
Chameleons

tasks.title: Capy Significance
tasks.description: Understanding why Capy is important in the Sui ecosystem
tasks.question: Why is the Capy collection significant in Sui's history?
options: It's the most expensive NFT collection on Sui
It was one of the first NFT collections on Sui mainnet
It was created by the Sui Foundation
It's the only deflationary NFT on Sui
tasks.correctAnswer: It was one of the first NFT collections on Sui mainnet

tasks.title: Capy Traits
tasks.description: Learn about the traits and attributes of Capy NFTs
tasks.question: What determines the rarity and uniqueness of individual Capy NFTs?
options: Only the issuance number
Various traits like accessories, colors, and backgrounds
The amount of SUI used to mint them
The wallet address that minted them
tasks.correctAnswer: Various traits like accessories, colors, and backgrounds

tasks.title: Breeding Mechanics
tasks.description: Understanding the unique breeding feature of Capy NFTs
tasks.question: What is special about Capy's breeding system?
options: Breeding is not possible with Capy NFTs
Breeding creates new NFTs with traits inherited from parent Capys
Breeding only works during full moons
Breeding requires paying fees to the developers
tasks.correctAnswer: Breeding creates new NFTs with traits inherited from parent Capys

tasks.title: Marketplace Integration
tasks.question: Where can Capy NFTs be traded?
options: Only on the official Capy website
On various Sui NFT marketplaces like BlueMove
Only through direct peer-to-peer transactions
They cannot be traded once minted
tasks.correctAnswer: On various Sui NFT marketplaces like BlueMove

tasks.title: Technical Implementation
tasks.description: Understanding how Capy NFTs are implemented on Sui
tasks.question: How are Capy NFTs stored on the Sui blockchain?
options: As simple tokens with metadata
As Move objects with dynamic fields for attributes
As off-chain data with only hashes on-chain
As simple images without on-chain attributes
tasks.correctAnswer: As Move objects with dynamic fields for attributes

tasks.title: Community Engagement
tasks.question: How does the Capy project engage with its community?
options: There is no community engagement
Through social media, events, and governance proposals
Only through paid memberships
By requiring holders to stake SUI
tasks.correctAnswer: Through social media, events, and governance proposals

tasks.title: Utility and Future
tasks.description: Understanding the utility and roadmap of Capy NFTs
tasks.question: What potential utility do Capy NFTs have beyond collectibility?
options: They function as governance tokens
They provide discounts on Sui gas fees
They may be used in future games and metaverse experiences
They automatically earn SUI rewards
tasks.correctAnswer: They may be used in future games and metaverse experiences
